quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #8
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead. Watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow merging traffic to join safely.

questions.question: To be ready for hazards ahead, you should:

options.text: Look at the entire road and both sides.
Stare straight ahead at all times.
Rest your left foot lightly on the brake pedal.
Keep your eyes on the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look at the entire road and both sides.
questions.explanation: You must constantly look for problems before they happen. Look ahead and also scan both sides of the road. Do not just stare straight ahead.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, they should:

options.text: Drive normally because emotions do not affect driving.
Drive faster because they are more alert.
Calm down and focus before starting the car.
Call a friend while driving to feel better.

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down and focus before starting the car.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can distract you from driving. Your mind may focus on your feelings instead of the road. Always calm down and clear your head before you start driving.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to upcoming curves. The road will curve to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a divided highway is coming. A divided highway has a barrier between traffic going in opposite directions.

questions.question: If you are driving in another driver's blind spot, you should:

options.text: Move ahead or fall back so the driver can see you.
Keep driving at the same speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move ahead or fall back so the driver can see you.
questions.explanation: Never stay in another driver's blind spot. Move forward or backward so the other driver can see you.

questions.question: When a school bus stops on a four-lane highway, you must stop only if:

options.text: You are traveling in the same direction as the bus.
You can see children crossing the street.
You are on the opposite side of the highway.
The bus driver waves you ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are traveling in the same direction as the bus.
questions.explanation: On a four-lane highway, only drivers going the same direction as the school bus must stop. Be careful around children near school buses.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Give the motorcycle a full lane to use.
Drive on the shoulder next to the motorcycle.
Let the motorcycle use only half of a lane.
Pass by using the same lane as the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the motorcycle a full lane to use.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full vehicle with the same road rights as any other vehicle. Give a motorcyclist a full lane width. A motorcycle needs space to move safely, even if it looks like there is room to share the lane.

questions.question: You are backing out of your driveway and see children playing nearby. Before you move, you should:

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children you are moving.
Honk your horn so the children hear you.
Walk to the back of your car to check if the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of your car to check if the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Always look through your back window for people and obstacles when backing up. Do not rely only on mirrors, especially when children are nearby. Get out and check behind your car before backing into or out of a driveway.

questions.question: This road sign shows:

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for an expressway exit.
The safest speed for an expressway entrance.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the recommended safe speed for a highway exit. The example shows 30 mph.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: Where is parking not allowed?
questions.explanation: Do not park on a crosswalk, on a highway bridge, or in a tunnel. Only park where it is legal and where other drivers can see your stopped car.

questions.question: If two vehicles reach a four-way stop at the same time:

options.text: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
The vehicle on the right must let the vehicle on the left go first.
Drivers must use hand signals to communicate.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, vehicles go in the order they arrive. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the left must give the right-of-way to the vehicle on the right.

questions.question: You are in the right lane of a highway and want to move to the left lane. You should:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for traffic behind you.
Look over your left shoulder for traffic in your blind spot.
Check your side mirror and turn on your signal.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check both mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure no other vehicles are in the lane you want to enter. Always signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a winding road. Slow down and be ready for the curves ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead is now a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line mean?

options.text: You may pass if it is safe.
Both lanes go the same direction.
You may pass even if it is dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A single dashed yellow line means both directions can pass. Only pass if it is safe and you will not interfere with oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, you should complete the turn into:

options.text: The lane closest to your previous lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane that is closest to the lane you came from.

questions.question: On slippery roads, what should you do?

options.text: Drive the speed limit, with caution.
Not drive more quickly than 20 mph.

questions.explanation: Slow down when rain, snow, or sleet makes the road slippery. You may need to drive slower than the speed limit when road conditions are bad.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Approach with extreme caution and cross only when you know no train is coming.
Turn your radio down to listen for an approaching train.
Only continue once a flagger clears you to proceed, if one is present.

questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings with extreme caution and cross only when no train is coming from either direction. Obey all instructions from flaggers if they are present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two one-way roadways separated by a median. Stay to the right.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians crossing or about to cross. Watch carefully for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign warns you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Yield to other vehicles and pedestrians. You may continue when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign that tells you what you must do. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: An inattentive driver is a driver who:

options.text: Looks at things off the road or daydreams while driving.
Makes eye contact with a passenger while driving.
Only watches the car in front.

questions.explanation: Do not get distracted by looking at passengers, searching for items, reading, sightseeing, or daydreaming. Keep checking the road, your mirrors, and your gauges regularly. These safe habits will help you stay focused while driving.

questions.question: If you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When you leave your vehicle, you must stop the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: These parking spaces are only for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver and at least one passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are only for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that these parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: When encountering an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove of their driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If another driver is threatening you or driving dangerously near you, stay calm. Slow down and let them pass. Create distance between your vehicles. Do not make eye contact or rude gestures.

questions.question: Motorcycles are entitled to:

options.text: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use the same full lane width as all other vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is prohibited. This sign means U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: When passing an emergency vehicle stopped on the side of the road, drivers should:

options.text: Move away from the emergency vehicle's lane or slow down.
Ask the emergency worker if they need help.
Move closer to the emergency vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move away from the emergency vehicle's lane or slow down.
questions.explanation: When driving past a stopped emergency vehicle, move out of the lane next to it if you can do so safely. If you cannot move over, you must slow down.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may be crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns drivers that a curve is coming.

questions.question: Your ability to stop is affected by:
questions.explanation: Road condition affects your ability to stop. You must slow down when roads are wet, icy, or in poor condition to maintain control and be able to stop safely.
